title: Tell Time with Halves and Quarters

stageA.sourceMathematics: Analog time has hour AND minute hands. Minute hand on12 means:00; on3 means:15 (quarter past), on6 means:30 (half past), on9 means:45 (quarter to). At7:30 hour hand lies between7 and8.
stageA.studentFacingAuthenticTask: Original Activity1 find authentic 4:00 versus wrong clock, half past7 versus wrong clock; DRAW hands for10:00 and1:30. Activity2 sort genuine THREE-CARD clock and time sets and say half past, quarter past/to.
stageA.originalMediaAndHumanLimits: Educator checks exact hand angle/position, actual publisher clock images, card matching and written words.
